stories.research_notes:
Here is what I found on the reported reopening of the nearly 400-year-old church in Itanhaém. The story is accurate in its major claims, but the reopening is *planned*, not yet completed, and some details are still provisional.

---

### What exists (primary / local sources)

- The restoration refers to the **Igreja Matriz de Sant’Anna**, located in the Centro Histórico of Itanhaém. The building is about 400 years old, constructed in the 17th century, and is a cultural, architectural, religious, and historic heritage site, officially listed by the Instituto do Patrimônio Histórico e Artístico Nacional (Iphan). ([cbnsantos.com.br](https://www.cbnsantos.com.br/noticias/noticias/igreja-matriz-sant-anna-itanhaem-fase-final-recuperacao-reabertura-8-de-dezembro.html?utm_source=openai))  
- The restoration works are in the final phase. Tasks include repairing and preserving original features like wooden flooring, internal walls, ceilings (“forros”), revestimentos (interior finishes), doors & windows (“esquadrias”), repairing the roof (telhas, wooden elements), renewing electrical systems, water supply and sewage, restoring staircases and tower platform, improving kitchen/cupboard (“copa”) and restrooms. ([itanhaem.sp.gov.br](https://www.itanhaem.sp.gov.br/2026/11/13/recuperacao-da-igreja-matriz-de-santanna-chega-a-fase-final-no-centro-historico-de-itanhaem/?utm_source=openai))  

---

### What is the planned outcome

- The **reopening date** is set for **8 December 2026**, coinciding with the celebrations in honor of Nossa Senhora da Conceição, the patron saint of the municipality. ([itanhaem.sp.gov.br](https://www.itanhaem.sp.gov.br/2026/11/13/recuperacao-da-igreja-matriz-de-santanna-chega-a-fase-final-no-centro-historico-de-itanhaem/?utm_source=openai))  
- The reopening is *expected*, not yet confirmed as completed; it remains subject to the successful completion of the remaining restoration work. ([cbnsantos.com.br](https://www.cbnsantos.com.br/noticias/noticias/recuperacao-igreja-matriz-santanna-itanhaem.html?utm_source=openai))  

---

### Independent verification

- Multiple independent local sources (e.g. CBN Santos, municipal announcements) corroborate the main facts: the nearly 400-year age of the church, its status as an Iphan‐protected heritage, ongoing restoration work, and the planned reopening on 8 December. ([cbnsantos.com.br](https://www.cbnsantos.com.br/noticias/noticias/igreja-matriz-sant-anna-itanhaem-fase-final-recuperacao-reabertura-8-de-dezembro.html?utm_source=openai))  
- No sources yet confirm that the reopening has actually happened (as of date), only that it is scheduled. ([cbnsantos.com.br](https://www.cbnsantos.com.br/noticias/noticias/recuperacao-igreja-matriz-santanna-itanhaem.html?utm_source=openai))  

---

### Research note summary

- Church: Igreja Matriz de Sant’Anna, Itanhaém, Brazil.  
- Age: Around 400 years; built in the 17th century.  
- Status: In restoration, final stage.  
- Restoration includes structural, aesthetic, and infrastructure repairs.  
- Reopening: Scheduled for 8 December 2026, aligning with local religious festival.  
- Outcome: *Planned*, not yet executed; no indication yet that the church has reopened.

---

If you like, I can look up live video or recent photos around 8 December to verify whether the reopening proceeded as planned. Do you want me to follow that up?
